vectors.name: wrap/seal-fixed
vectors.description: Group key K_2 wrapped to bob, with fixed KEM randomness (deterministic). enc (1120) || ciphertext (48) = 1168 bytes.

vectors.name: wrap/open-wrong-recipient-pid
vectors.description: The info binds the recipient pid.

vectors.name: wrap/open-ciphertext-bit-flipped
vectors.description: A bit flipped in the AEAD ciphertext (byte 1120 + 10, after enc).

vectors.name: wrap/open-tag-bit-flipped
vectors.description: A bit flipped in the last byte (the AEAD tag).

vectors.name: wrap/open-enc-bit-flipped-ml-kem-part
vectors.description: A bit flipped in the ML-KEM part of enc: decapsulation yields another secret (implicit rejection), the open fails.

vectors.name: wrap/open-enc-bit-flipped-x25519-part
vectors.description: A bit flipped in the X25519 part of enc (the last 32 bytes before the AEAD ciphertext).

vectors.name: wrap/open-too-short
vectors.description: Fewer bytes than enc and a tag.

vectors.name: wrap/open-sealed-by-python-cryptography
vectors.description: A wrap sealed by Python's cryptography 50 (hpke.Suite with KEM.MLKEM768_X25519), an independent implementation; random ephemeral key, so open only.

vectors.name: wrap/select-right-after-wrong-key
vectors.description: A wrap that opens but holds a key that does not match the commitment, then the right one: the right one is used.

vectors.name: wrap/select-right-before-wrong-key
vectors.description: The right wrap first, then a wrong one: the same key.

vectors.name: wrap/select-right-among-garbage
vectors.description: Garbage (1168 zero bytes), a wrap for another epoch, a wrong key and the right wrap.

vectors.name: wrap/select-none-right
vectors.description: Only wraps that fail the check: no key.
